name: Hexcrawl Map
description: Turns a map image into a pan/zoom hex map with fog of war. Explored hexes come from published notes (Hex 68, or hex: 68 in frontmatter); clicking one shows its notes in a side panel.
author: Jake Hill

settings.name: Hex note prefix
settings.description: Published notes named '<prefix> <number>' reveal that hex, e.g. 'Hex 68'.

settings.name: Thin fog next to explored hexes
settings.description: Hexes bordering an explored hex are shown through lighter fog.

settings.name: Hex numbers
settings.description: Which hexes get their number drawn on the map.

settings.name: Clicking an explored hex
settings.description: panel = show its notes in a side panel on the map; links = small popup with links to the notes.

settings.name: Fog opacity
settings.description: 0 to 1. Lower lets players make out terrain under the fog.

settings.name: Fog coverage
settings.description: map = the whole map area up to the frame (circle of 'Fog radius', or the whole image for rectangular grids); grid = hexes only; image = everything.

settings.name: Fog radius
settings.description: Radius of the fogged map area as a fraction of image width, used when coverage is map and the grid is circular.

settings.name: Map height
settings.description: CSS height of the map viewer on the page.

settings.name: Hex radius
settings.description: Centre-to-corner hex radius as a fraction of image width.

settings.name: Grid origin X
settings.description: X of one hex centre, as a fraction of image width.

settings.name: Grid origin Y
settings.description: Y of the same hex centre, as a fraction of image width.

settings.name: Circular grid radius
settings.description: Only hexes whose centre is within this radius (fraction of image width) of the image centre exist. 0 = whole image.
